<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>

response.content: {"critique": "The claim is that the problem of handlers manually recategorizing garage estimates misfiled as correspondence remains open. I checked the five most similar items: story 4127 (bulk document upload, completed), story 4129 (supplier contact details, completed), the Summer release notes page, the Task overview page, and story 4134 (task list improvements, in progress). None address document categorization or the misfiling of garage estimates as correspondence; all similarities are very low (≤0.06) and the completed stories solve unrelated problems. No shipped story or roadmap item covers this problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
